name: fqc-snowflake
description: Read-only Snowflake access for FQC-ARR. Executes the SELECT-only sql_template rows that the sub-agents emit (ValidationMatrix tie-outs against finance_prod/dev/qa and Salesforce source). The agent never opens a raw connection and never writes.

securityScheme.note: Sana holds the token; role mirrors the invoking user. Fallback local: SSO externalbrowser, ROLE_ANALYTICS_ENGINEER, ANALYTICS_ENGINEER_WH.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a single read-only SELECT/CTE query and return rows. Rejects any non-SELECT statement (no INSERT/UPDATE/MERGE/DDL). Used to populate ValidationMatrix value columns.

sql.description: A single SELECT/CTE statement. Non-SELECT is rejected.
